name: Memoryglass Strand
introDiscord:
A silver beach appears beneath your feet.

Every grain of sand reflects a memory instead of your face.

Some belong to you.

Most do not.
introTwitch:
A silver beach appears beneath your feet.

Every grain of sand reflects a memory instead of your face.

Some belong to you.

Most do not.

memoryglass-strand-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across Memoryglass Strand.

left.message:
A patch of memoryglass shows Shizuki sleeping beneath Moonlit Reef's
coral.

The peaceful memory becomes tangible enough to restore you.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message:
A Memoryglass Crab crawls from a reflection of a beach that no longer
exists.

forward.message: A cache appears inside the reflection before appearing in reality.

memoryglass-strand-depths.prompt: Deeper within Memoryglass Strand, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message:
One Berry sits beside a memory of Shizuki and Glimmer arguing over a
map.

Shizuki's caption:

'Historical evidence Glimmer was wrong.

Glimmer says memory was edited.

Slander.'

right.message:
A coffer contains objects from three different versions of the same
afternoon.

forward.message: A Memoryglass Crab charges across yesterday's shadow.

memoryglass-strand-threshold.prompt: Near Beach of Borrowed Yesterdays, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message: A Crab crawls out of Shizuki's reflected campsite.

right.message:
A memory of the King’s Festival fountain briefly becomes real and
restores you.
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: Star Candies glitter inside the reflection of Moonlit Reef.

boss-antechamber.name: Beach of Borrowed Yesterdays
boss-antechamber.prompt:
Beach of Borrowed Yesterdays fills with scenes from places you've
already crossed.

bossPromptDiscord:
Beach of Borrowed Yesterdays fills with scenes from places you've
already crossed.

Something enormous begins collecting the memories into its claws.

Use /yes to enter or /no to let yesterday remain yesterday.
bossPromptTwitch:
Beach of Borrowed Yesterdays fills with scenes from places you've
already crossed.

Something enormous begins collecting the memories into its claws.

Use !yes to enter or !no to let yesterday remain yesterday.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Beach of Borrowed Yesterdays. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
The reflected shoreline shatters.

Recollection Clawlord reveals itself!

completionText:
The broken memories settle.

One remains:

Shizuki and Glimmer walking away from the Sunken King's Festival.

Then it fades.
